body:
4:00pm  got my refil for Xanax, adderall (instant release), ambien, and robaxin (spelling? Methocarbamol [spelling?]). Been about a month so I decided to treat myself a bit.
4:15 pm take 2mg of Xanax to make it through the rest of class.
5:00 finish class, feeling the normal Xanax high, that pseudo tipsy feeling I get, you know general xanax high
Take a nap at home (pisses I fell asleep) so I decided when I woke up to kick it back in and try an experiment.
6:30 I take 5mg adderall (just to make sure I don't fall asleep), 1 mg of Xanax, 5 mg of ambien, and 500 mg of methocarbonal (or however it's spelled, it's a muscle relaxer) along with around 8 grams of kratom (for me it's a light dose, just trying to get a hint of all the effects of these together at the moment) and swallow the kratom and methocarbonol. While waiting for these to take effect I simultaneously start crushing the ambien, Xanax, and adderall I listed above and rail it. Burned like a bitch for some reason.
6:45 starting to notice slight effects, generic benzo feeling, alert though from the adderall coming on and the ambien seems to just be increasing the benzo feeling. Nothing from the orally injeasted medications and kratom yet.
07:00 I decide to take just a swig of whiskey to speed up the effects and kick it in. Feeling super relaxed now. Mainly feel the benzodiazepines and ambien bonding to my GABA receptors. I'm feeling sedated, but mentally awake from the small dosage of adderall just to keep me awake. Also I have been hitting my vape much more often than usually, not exactly sure what to attribute it to, possibly the xanax because that is the strongest feeling in getting so far and I also vape often when I use Xanax.
7:10 pm notice the kratom now. The euphoria-type feeling I get from it isn't there, just not as prominent, I'm in a good mood and feeling great. Usually on Xanax I like to go out and do Shit, mainly stupid Shit and waste money, I feel like just chilling at home and enjoying this.
I feel like just chilling at home and enjoying this.
730:  this is now actually starting to feel extremely similar to an actual opiate for some reason, with a slight benzo feeling to it. Euphoric and feeling great. Even nodding a little bit, but not the kind of nod that makes me want to go to sleep, just nod and enjoy it.
7:45 Really talkative and happy, feeling the effects of everything, mostly the Xanax though. Unfortunately I have to go to bed soon, but overall I liked this  combo, will do it again tomorrow.
Pretty much I was mostly a Xanax experience but with better sedation euphoria and mood, even a little nod every now and then.
Fav combo other than actual opiates.
Btw I have prescriptions for all these and get randomly drug tested which is why I used the kratom and not an actual opiate.
